plan.title: Recreate Order with Empty Optional Fields

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary for the buyer-side case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Allow buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Confirm that the Recreate Order window opened.

args.goal: In the open Recreate Order window, leave the custom duration number empty, the field with placeholder "10" empty, Delivery Date empty, the field with placeholder "Select date" empty, Schedule this event? unchecked, and the field with placeholder "Select time" empty; click Create Order and record any field error, message, whether the window remains open, and whether a new order is created.

steps.note: Perform the requested empty-input submission and observe the app's response, which has no fixed expected wording or state in the case.
Ensure the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or rendering corruption.
